name: mod-scout
description: Watches your prompts at zero token cost: suggests the installed mod that fits, sets your focus goal, turns prompts you repeat into one-word slash commands, and builds new mods on request.

autoMacros.title: Auto macros
autoMacros.description: When you send the same prompt a third time, make a slash command that sends it.

autoFocus.title: Auto focus goal
autoFocus.description: Set daily-driver's focus goal from your first real task of the session when none is set.
